Lost? Don't know how to get to the event? Worry no more bestie!

We got you covered because getting to the venue should be the least of your worries (save your energy for the chaos instead).

Whether you’re commuting, booking a ride, or just vibing your way through the city, we’ve prepared a quick and easy transportation guide to help you arrive safe, sound, and ready to scream your lungs out.

🗺 𝐏𝐫𝐨 𝐓𝐢𝐩𝐬
• Leave a little early (traffic is real, we don’t make the rules)
• Bring extra patience… and maybe snacks 
• Don’t be shy to ask for directions. People are nicer than you think!

No more “saan ba ‘to?” moments. Just smooth travels all the way to the BESTEST night ever.

Check the full guide below and plan your route ahead!
See you there, and don’t be late!
